bit_interpretation: 1 retains the mechanism, 0 removes it; consumer=0 freezes initial carrier shares; investor=0 jointly disables profit and all operating feedback. Native construction and physical constraints remain.

interaction: Mobius first/pair/triple differences relative to 000; explicitly report the interaction terms rather than calling single-removal deltas additive.
